description: What changed since your last call: the change events PreReason records. A live briefing's state label changing, a tracked release becoming known, and, for the companies you name, figures stored for a newer period, an event driven situation turning on, and filed news. Each event says what changed, when it happened, when PreReason knew it and where to read it next (the briefing or metric to fetch with get_context or get_metric); it carries no value. Pass the next_cursor of your previous call to read only what is new; without one, the last 24 hours. Needs an API key on an account with basic access or above.

companies.description: Companies whose events to read: a USA ticker or CIK (NVDA), a Japanese securities code (7203), a Korean stock code (005930) or an Indian company's ISIN (INE018A01030). At most 200. A company's events reach only a call that names it.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of your previous call. Left out, the read starts from the last day of events.

limit.description: Events one call returns, 1 to 100. Default 50.

types.description: The event types to read. Every type when left out.

name: get_changes
title: Get Changes
